_what: The short answer to a read the page already holds (src/read-fingerprint.mjs). A page that holds the last answer to a read sends `request_header` with the fingerprint of that answer's body; when the Worker's answer to the same read has the same fingerprint it sends `{ "same": true }` with `answer_header` set to `1` instead of the whole body, and the page uses what it holds. `fingerprint_characters` is how much of the BLAKE3 hash is sent (32 hex characters, 128 bits). Only a read whose body is at most `most_bytes` is compared, and an answer that carries any of `keep_whole_when_headers` (the page reads those headers beside the body) is always sent whole. `path_prefix` is where reads are answered this way.
